meta.title: km to cm Converter — Kilometer to Centimeter
meta.description: Convert Kilometer (km) to Centimeter (cm) instantly. 1 km = 100000 cm. Free, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Convert kilometers (km) to centimeters (cm) instantly. Both measure length, so the relationship is strictly linear: each kilometer equals 100000 centimeters. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One kilometer is equal to **100000 centimeters**. To go the other way, one centimeter equals **1.000000e-5 kilometers**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> centimeters = kilometers × 100000

Worked example — converting 10 kilometers:

10 × 100000 = **1000000 cm**.

To invert, divide by 100000 (or multiply by 1.000000e-5).
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 km ≈ 100000 cm. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Kilometer and Centimeter both measure length; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many centimeters are in 1 kilometer?
**A:** 100000 centimeters.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert km to cm?
**A:** centimeters = kilometers × 100000.

**Q:** How do I convert cm back to km?
**A:** Multiply by 1.000000e-5 (or divide by 100000).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this km to cm converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
